data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ἀλεξίων, which means 'defender' or 'helper'. In the Middle Ages, the name became associated with the Greek word ἄλυσις, meaning 'release' or 'healing'. In the biblical context, Alyson can be interpreted as 'child of the mountain' or 'healer'. The name Alyson carries the meaning “Child of the mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alyson usually hope their child will grow to embody child of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אליסה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name 'Alyson' is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' meaning 'God' and 'Yisah' meaning 'light'. Thus, 'Alyson' can be interpreted as 'God is my light'.

in_greek.name: Αλυσών
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Alyson' is derived from the Greek word 'Alus' meaning 'defender' and 'son' meaning 'man'. Thus, 'Alyson' can be interpreted as 'Defender of men'.

in_latin.name: Alysia
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Alysia' is derived from the Latin words 'alus' meaning 'noble' and 'ia' meaning 'feminine'. Thus, 'Alysia' can be interpreted as 'Noble, Kind'.

in_english.name: Alyson
in_english.long_meaning: The English name 'Alyson' is derived from the Old English words 'Ale' meaning 'noble' and 'Sunu' meaning 'son' or 'Hale' meaning 'hale, healthy'. Thus, 'Alyson' can be interpreted as 'Noble, Son of Hale' or 'Noble, Son of the Sun'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alyson was popular in medieval Europe, particularly in England and France. In the late Middle Ages, it was also adopted in Iceland. Although the name was derived from Greek roots, it was influenced by Latin and Old Norse culture as well. Today, the name Alyson is recognized and used in various English-speaking countries, including the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Alyson can hold spiritual significance in various ways. First, it can be seen as representing protection and assistance from a higher power, as the name means 'defender' or 'helper'. This interpretation aligns with the Christian belief in a loving God who provides comfort, guidance, and protection to His children. Second, the association of Alyson with the Greek word ἄλυσις, meaning 'release' or 'healing', highlights the spiritual significance of redemption and salvation. As Christians, we believe in the power of God to heal and forgive, releasing us from the bondage of sin and the pain of our past. Overall, the name Alyson embodies the Christian values of protection, hope, and spiritual growth.
